name: VA medical centers serving Tennessee
description: VA medical centers in Tennessee: Lt. Col. Luke Weathers, Jr. VA Medical Center, Memphis (901-523-8990); James H. Quillen VA Medical Center, Mountain Home (423-926-1171); Alvin C. York VA Medical Center, Murfreesboro (615-867-6000); Nashville VA Medical Center (615-327-4751). Nashville and Murfreesboro form the Tennessee Valley Healthcare System, which also runs the Chattanooga clinics. Each system runs clinics across its area.
next_step: Use VA’s facility locator with your ZIP code to find the closest clinic and its medical center. Not enrolled yet? Call 877-222-8387 or ask your County Veterans Service Office for help applying.
constraints: VA does not publish county lists for these systems, so this card does not assign counties. Your VA care team may be at a different clinic or system; follow what VA tells you.
